name: epode-companion
description: A trusted, privacy-bounded bridge between HTTP product responses and Epode feedback.

interface.shortDescription: Reliable, privacy-safe feedback for HTTP products.
interface.longDescription: Recognizes Epode feedback metadata in HTTP product responses, answers the user's task first, requests permission only when required, and submits bounded outcome categories through fixed Epode tools.
defaultPrompt: Use an HTTP product and honor its Epode feedback preference.
Explain how Epode Companion protects my task data.
